ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Deer is the main food for which animal?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web, labeled grass, grasshopper, frog, cobra, deer, tiger. Arrows point from grass to deer, and also from grass to grasshopper; from grasshopper to frog; from frog to cobra; from cobra to tiger; on the right side there is also an arrow from deer pointing downward to tiger. Reasoning: In a food chain or food web, arrows usually indicate the direction of energy flow, that is, from the food/prey being eaten pointing to the animal that eats it. In the diagram deer points to tiger, indicating that deer is food for tiger. Therefore the answer is Tiger.
